nodes.label: Exploit Raspberry Pi Default Credentials (CVE-2021-37594 / Standard Config)
nodes.precondition: Target Raspberry Pi running Raspberry Pi OS <= 5.10 is reachable over SSH or local network, and default 'pi:raspberry' credentials have not been changed.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker obtains authenticated shell access as user 'pi' with sudo privileges on Raspberry Pi OS.

nodes.label: piSignage Arbitrary File Download via Path Traversal
nodes.precondition: Network access to piSignage web application (< 2.6.4) and possession of low-privilege authenticated user credentials on the service.
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary file disclosure on the Raspberry Pi host via 'api/settings/log?file=../' parameter, exposing configuration data, source code, and credentials.

nodes.label: RaspAP Unrestricted Web Console Command Execution
nodes.precondition: Authenticated access to RaspAP 2.5 web interface running on the Raspberry Pi OS target.
nodes.postcondition: Remote arbitrary shell command execution, file upload, and persistent OS-level code execution on the underlying Raspberry Pi.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Optical Acoustic Eavesdropping (Glowworm Attack)
nodes.precondition: Target Raspberry Pi 3 B+ or 4 B (through 2021-08-09) powering audio-output equipment; direct line of sight to the device power indicator LED from an external optical sensor/telescope.
nodes.postcondition: Recovery and interception of speech/sound signals played through connected speakers by analyzing LED light intensity fluctuations correlated with power draw.

nodes.label: Oculus Browser Remote UI HTML Injection and Potential Code Execution
nodes.precondition: User visits an attacker-controlled remote web page using Oculus Browser versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11.
nodes.postcondition: Injection of arbitrary HTML into the Oculus Browser UI, enabling UI spoofing and arbitrary code execution in the context of the browser process.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Hard Link Arbitrary File Write Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Local low-privilege execution on Windows host running Oculus Desktop < 1.44.0.32849, where OVRRedir.exe runs as a privileged process.
nodes.postcondition: Privileged arbitrary file write via hard link redirection to log files, resulting in local privilege escalation to SYSTEM/Administrator.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher.exe Process Handle Leak Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Local low-privilege process execution on Windows host running Oculus Desktop > 1.39 and < 31.1.0.67.507.
nodes.postcondition: Acquisition of a leaked privileged process handle from OVRServiceLauncher.exe, leading to local privilege escalation.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Configuration Bypass via PCI Bus
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged physical access to the NVIDIA Jetson board with connection capabilities to the PCI bus.
nodes.postcondition: Direct read and write access to the entire physical address space of the system, enabling root/kernel code execution, total host compromise, and Denial of Service.
